# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was written in Quarto using the `cosmo` theme with
local overrides in `practicum.scss`. R code is executed by
`knitr` and rendered with `downlit` for function-level
hyperlinks.

Body text is set in Source Sans 3 (fallbacks Inter, Helvetica
Neue, Arial), and headings and interface elements use the same
face. Code is set in JetBrains Mono (fallbacks Fira Mono, Menlo).
Syntax highlighting uses the accessibility-tuned `arrow` palette,
which is the same in HTML and PDF output.

PDF output is produced by `xelatex` with the `scrbook`
document class at 6.5 × 9 inches. The PDF monofont is
DejaVu Sans Mono for complete Unicode coverage of
box-drawing and mathematical glyphs.

The prose, figures, and exercises are licensed CC BY 4.0. Code
blocks printed in the text are MIT; the package code and build
scripts are GPL-3. Third-party images are excluded from both and
carry their own terms, recorded in [Credits](credits.qmd). The
full statement is in `LICENSE.md`.

Source available at <https://github.com/rgt47/practicum>.

## Build environment

The lockfile `renv.lock` at the root of the repository records
the package versions the book is meant to be built with. However,
this edition was built against the R library installed on the
build machine, not a library restored from the lockfile. The
repository also contains no Dockerfile for the book, so neither
the operating system nor the system libraries are pinned.
@sec-renv and @sec-docker teach you to close that gap.

The tables below record what was actually used. R generates them
when this page is executed, so they cannot drift from the build
they describe. Because the book is rendered with Quarto's `freeze`
option, they describe the last render in which this page was
executed.

A 'no' in the last column of @tbl-colophon-packages means either
that this edition was built with a version other than the one the
lockfile records, or that the lockfile does not record the package
at all. In both cases a reader who restores the lockfile will not
get the environment that produced this book. This is the kind of
silent failure that habit 4 exists to make loud.
